our_interpretation: The context concerns whether small-model results using limited synthetic datasets remove an industry-wide training-data constraint.
Running out means an approaching constraint on useful human-generated training data, not that all possible data have already been exhausted.
Broken refers to error-prone generators; it does not by itself establish that every generated example is wrong.
In many cases means a recurring practice, without an invented numerical prevalence threshold.
This is a causal assessment of a proposed remedy, not a conditional forecast with a deadline. Later research can test the mechanism.
